row.notes: (tbl,obj,mask): robin-hood lookup of s32 key obj+0x2a8 in tbl (+0x68 mult, +0x70 slots, +0x78 ctrl, +0x88 mask); entry has up to 3 optional conditions (flags +0x18/+0x78/+0x88) evaluated on obj+0x1030 components; a failed condition counts only if its bit (+0x14/+0x74/+0x84) in mask is clear. Returns AND of the three. (lane owner review requested) Better name: Ui_MyTeamCareer_CheckEntryConditions (bound record keeps its name).

verify.notes: V10320 Hashes int at slot_obj+0x55*8 into map at +0x68, then evaluates availability conditions and returns a bool-like flag rather than returning the entry.
